observed.caption: A dense overhead view of numerous carved wooden masks and small figurines arranged together on a dark surface.
observed.description: A large number of carved wooden masks in varying sizes, shapes, colors and patterns are densely arranged to fill the frame on a dark textured cloth. The masks show diverse carved features including closed eyes, open mouths, geometric triangle patterns, striped textures, and weathered surfaces in shades of dark brown, black, tan, beige and red with white accents. Interspersed among the masks are small wooden figurines depicting human forms, a carved torso with breasts near the center, an elephant-shaped carving on the right, and a small woven basket containing green and yellow beaded necklaces near the center-left. The display is viewed from directly above under natural daylight, with a light brown ground visible at the top right edge and a white sack partially visible in the upper right corner.
